import warnings
import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, cross_val_score
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

table = np.loadtxt("data/pilot.csv", delimiter=",", skiprows=1)
X, y = table[:, :-1], table[:, -1]
n = X.shape[1]
prods = [X[:, i] * X[:, j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n)]
Xa = np.column_stack([X] + prods)

variants = {
    "penalty='l1' (step-11 code)": dict(penalty="l1", solver="liblinear", random_state=0, max_iter=5000),
    "l1_ratio=1 (API-correct)":    dict(l1_ratio=1, solver="liblinear", random_state=0, max_iter=5000),
}
for name, kwargs in variants.items():
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        pipe = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(**kwargs))
        auc = cross_val_score(pipe, Xa, y, cv=StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=0),
                              scoring="roc_auc", n_jobs=1).mean()
        pipe.fit(Xa, y)
        coefs = pipe[-1].coef_[0]
    print(f"{name}: cv AUC {auc:.4f}, zero coefs {int((coefs == 0).sum())}/78, "
          f"warnings {len(caught)}")
EOF
